text: yeah this works well. here is what i would do next: [Image #1] instrument this a bit further, show things like, triangle count, chunk count, last edit date, and also a easy way to rename existing and delete / remove entirely

resolution: Instrumented Map Workspaces with live/last-render triangle counts, non-mutating on-disk RMAP chunk counts, and modification timestamps. Added stable-id friendly renaming (including the chrome title) plus an explicit two-step recursive delete for inactive maps, with backend guards against deleting the active pointer. Map lifecycle tests pass 8/8, native map tests pass, the editor dev bundle compiles, and the full ReleaseFast host compile is green; the remaining gate is the requested user visual check in the dev host.
